title: Enable CUPS debug logging to diagnose printing issues
summary: Change the CUPS log level to 'debug' and view the error log in real-time to see exactly what is happening when a print job fails.

steps.explain: Edit /etc/cups/cupsd.conf and change the line starting with LogLevel to 'LogLevel debug'.
View the last 100 lines of the error log and keep it open to watch for new errors as you try to print.

rollback.explain: Restore the default log level (usually 'info' or 'notice') in /etc/cups/cupsd.conf.

warnings: Debug logs can be very large and fill up disk space if left enabled for a long time.
